name: Google Calendar
notes: Priced Workspace: Business Starter $7 a user (no booking pages); booking pages need Standard, $16.80 flexible monthly or $14 on an annual term. Free personal Calendar not checked.

name: Calendly
free_plan_limits: 1 event type, 1 calendar connection, one-on-one only
best_for: Simple meeting links for solo workers
notes: Page shows $10 (Standard) and $16 (Teams) per seat, apparently yearly; monthly rate not stated. Payments on Standard and up; round robin on Teams. SMS reminders not mentioned.

name: Cal.com
free_plan_limits: 1 user, unlimited links and calendars, payments and SMS notifications included
since_note: Started 2021 as Calendso, launched on Product Hunt in 2021 (CB Insights; Cal.com about page).
notes: Teams is $12 per user monthly, 25% off if paid yearly. Open-source status is from the public repo, not the pricing page.

name: Acuity
since_note: Company founded about 2006; Squarespace's 2019 press called it a 13-year-old company (Squarespace press coverage).
best_for: Appointment businesses with a few staff
notes: Starter $20, Standard $34, Premium $69 monthly (yearly $16/$27/$55). Standard has up to 6 calendars and SMS reminders; API is Premium only. 7-day free trial.

name: TidyCal
free_plan_limits: Unlimited bookings, 1 connected calendar, 1% fee on payments
best_for: Cheap booking, even a one-time deal
notes: Pro is $12 a month or $99 a year. $29 and $79 one-time lifetime deals are sold on AppSumo. Unlimited SMS only on Pro; round robin on Agency and Pro.
